reading: A review commissioned by the government is expected to recommend a radical overhaul that could reduce some young people's welfare entitlements.
According to the Times, Alan Milburn's report will recommend moving under-25s off the main sickness and disability benefits.
The government has tasked Milburn, a former Labour health secretary, with helping reduce the proportion of 18- to 24-year-olds outside education, employment or training, reported as one in eight.
The report is expected to propose ending under-25s' eligibility for the health element of universal credit and for personal independence payment, both forms of state support.
A replacement allowance would match the basic universal credit rate.
Some people could receive additional help with everyday expenses associated with their conditions.
Those with more serious disabilities who are unable to work would receive a new payment at a higher rate.
Milburn is also expected to recommend billions in employment support, including work placements, job subsidies and individual advisers.
Milburn frames the central choice as whether to prioritise young people's longer-term life chances or their immediate financial circumstances.
He has warned that the changes would involve difficult consequences for both existing and new recipients.
The proposed approach would combine incentives with sanctions, since young people could lose some support if they did not engage with the additional employment services.
Milburn says substantial spending would be needed to rebuild the system from scratch.
Were Milburn's recommendations to be approved, monetary savings for the British state could still take almost a decade to emerge.
A government spokesperson has promised a safety net for the most vulnerable and those unable to work.
The government is expected to pursue legislation implementing the plans in the new year.

vocabulary.definition: Formally requested by an organisation or authority to investigate an issue or produce a report.
A thorough redesign that changes how a system operates, rather than adjusting individual details.
Forms of support that people have a right to receive under the applicable rules.
Public funds used to cover part of a cost, here to encourage employment opportunities.
Presents an issue in a particular way that directs attention towards certain choices or considerations.
Opportunities or advantages intended to encourage a particular action.
Penalties for failing to meet requirements, here the possible loss of some welfare support.
Starting again with the fundamental design rather than simply modifying existing arrangements.
Reductions in the amount of money spent, distinguished from other possible improvements.
Support intended to prevent vulnerable people from being left without essential help.

entries.ja: ある問題の調査や報告書の作成を、組織や公的機関から正式に依頼されたこと。
entries.ko: 문제를 조사하거나 보고서를 작성하도록 조직이나 당국으로부터 공식적으로 요청받은 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 受组织或主管机构正式委托，调查某个问题或编写报告。
entries.es: Encargado formalmente por una organización o autoridad para investigar un asunto o elaborar un informe.
entries.pt-BR: Solicitado formalmente por uma organização ou autoridade para investigar uma questão ou produzir um relatório.
entries.fr: Demandé officiellement par une organisation ou une autorité afin d’examiner une question ou de produire un rapport.
entries.de: Von einer Organisation oder Behörde offiziell damit beauftragt, eine Frage zu untersuchen oder einen Bericht zu erstellen.

entries.ja: 個々の細部を調整するのではなく、制度の仕組みや運営方法を変える全面的な再設計。
entries.ko: 개별적인 세부 사항을 조정하는 것이 아니라 제도가 작동하는 방식을 바꾸는 전면적인 재설계.
entries.zh-Hans: 全面重新设计一个体系，改变其运作方式，而不只是调整个别细节。
entries.es: Rediseño completo que cambia cómo funciona un sistema, en lugar de ajustar detalles individuales.
entries.pt-BR: Reformulação completa que muda a maneira como um sistema funciona, em vez de apenas ajustar detalhes específicos.
entries.fr: Refonte complète qui modifie le fonctionnement d’un système, plutôt que d’en ajuster certains détails.
entries.de: Eine umfassende Neugestaltung, die die Funktionsweise eines Systems verändert, statt einzelne Details anzupassen.

entries.ja: 適用される規則に基づいて、人々が受ける権利を持つ各種の支援。
entries.ko: 적용되는 규정에 따라 사람들이 받을 권리가 있는 여러 형태의 지원.
entries.zh-Hans: 按照适用规定，人们有权获得的各类支持。
entries.es: Formas de apoyo que las personas tienen derecho a recibir según las normas aplicables.
entries.pt-BR: Formas de apoio que as pessoas têm direito de receber de acordo com as regras aplicáveis.
entries.fr: Formes d’aide que les personnes ont le droit de recevoir selon les règles applicables.
entries.de: Formen der Unterstützung, auf die Menschen nach den geltenden Regeln Anspruch haben.

entries.ja: 費用の一部をまかなうために使われる公的資金。ここでは、雇用機会を増やすためのもの。
entries.ko: 비용의 일부를 충당하는 데 쓰이는 공공 자금으로, 여기서는 고용 기회를 늘리기 위한 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 用于承担部分费用的公共资金，这里旨在促进就业机会的增加。
entries.es: Fondos públicos que cubren parte de un costo, en este caso para fomentar las oportunidades de empleo.
entries.pt-BR: Recursos públicos usados para cobrir parte de um custo, neste caso para incentivar oportunidades de emprego.
entries.fr: Fonds publics servant à couvrir une partie d’un coût, ici pour favoriser les possibilités d’emploi.
entries.de: Öffentliche Mittel, die einen Teil der Kosten decken, hier zur Förderung von Beschäftigungsmöglichkeiten.

entries.ja: 特定の選択肢や考慮すべき点に注意が向くような形で、問題を提示する。
entries.ko: 특정 선택지나 고려 사항에 관심이 쏠리도록 어떤 문제를 특정한 방식으로 제시한다.
entries.zh-Hans: 以特定方式呈现一个问题，引导人们关注某些选择或需要考虑的因素。
entries.es: Presenta un asunto de una manera determinada que dirige la atención hacia ciertas opciones o consideraciones.
entries.pt-BR: Apresenta uma questão de uma maneira específica que direciona a atenção para certas escolhas ou aspectos a considerar.
entries.fr: Présente une question d’une manière particulière qui attire l’attention sur certains choix ou éléments à prendre en compte.
entries.de: Stellt ein Thema auf eine bestimmte Weise dar und lenkt damit die Aufmerksamkeit auf bestimmte Entscheidungsmöglichkeiten oder Gesichtspunkte.

entries.ja: 特定の行動を促すことを目的とした機会や利点。
entries.ko: 특정 행동을 장려하기 위한 기회나 이점.
entries.zh-Hans: 旨在鼓励某种行动的机会或好处。
entries.es: Oportunidades o ventajas destinadas a fomentar una acción concreta.
entries.pt-BR: Oportunidades ou vantagens destinadas a estimular uma determinada ação.
entries.fr: Possibilités ou avantages destinés à encourager une action particulière.
entries.de: Möglichkeiten oder Vorteile, die zu einer bestimmten Handlung anregen sollen.

entries.ja: 求められる条件を満たさなかった場合の罰則。ここでは、福祉支援の一部を失う可能性を指す。
entries.ko: 요구 조건을 충족하지 못했을 때 받는 불이익으로, 여기서는 복지 지원의 일부를 잃을 가능성을 뜻한다.
entries.zh-Hans: 因未满足要求而受到的处罚，这里指可能失去部分福利支持。
entries.es: Penalizaciones por no cumplir los requisitos, en este caso la posible pérdida de parte de las ayudas sociales.
entries.pt-BR: Penalidades por não cumprir os requisitos, neste caso a possível perda de parte dos benefícios sociais.
entries.fr: Pénalités en cas de non-respect des exigences, ici la perte possible d’une partie des aides sociales.
entries.de: Strafen für die Nichterfüllung von Anforderungen, hier der mögliche Verlust eines Teils der Sozialleistungen.

entries.ja: 既存の仕組みを単に修正するのではなく、基本的な設計からやり直すこと。
entries.ko: 기존 방식을 단순히 수정하는 것이 아니라 기본 설계부터 다시 시작하는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 从根本设计重新开始，而不只是修改现有安排。
entries.es: Empezando de nuevo desde el diseño básico, en lugar de limitarse a modificar lo que ya existe.
entries.pt-BR: Começando de novo pelo projeto básico, em vez de apenas modificar a estrutura existente.
entries.fr: En repartant de la conception de base, plutôt qu’en modifiant simplement les dispositions existantes.
entries.de: Erneut mit der grundlegenden Gestaltung beginnen, statt lediglich bestehende Regelungen zu ändern.

entries.ja: 支出する金額が減ること。他の改善の可能性とは区別される。
entries.ko: 지출 금액의 감소로, 그 밖의 가능한 개선과는 구별된다.
entries.zh-Hans: 支出金额的减少，区别于其他可能的改善。
entries.es: Reducciones en la cantidad de dinero que se gasta, diferenciadas de otras posibles mejoras.
entries.pt-BR: Reduções na quantia de dinheiro gasta, consideradas separadamente de outras possíveis melhorias.
entries.fr: Réductions des sommes dépensées, à distinguer d’autres améliorations possibles.
entries.de: Verringerungen der Geldausgaben, die von anderen möglichen Verbesserungen zu unterscheiden sind.

entries.ja: 弱い立場にある人々が、必要不可欠な助けを受けられなくなるのを防ぐための支援。
entries.ko: 취약한 처지에 있는 사람들이 꼭 필요한 도움을 받지 못하는 상황을 막기 위한 지원.
entries.zh-Hans: 旨在防止处境脆弱的人得不到必要帮助的支持。
entries.es: Apoyo destinado a evitar que las personas vulnerables se queden sin ayuda esencial.
entries.pt-BR: Apoio destinado a evitar que pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade fiquem sem ajuda essencial.
entries.fr: Soutien destiné à éviter que les personnes vulnérables se retrouvent sans aide essentielle.
entries.de: Unterstützung, die verhindern soll, dass schutzbedürftige Menschen ohne grundlegende Hilfe bleiben.
